name: MilkDrop Visualizer
description: Stream real-time waveform data from any playing Sendspin group to the Music Assistant web interface, powering the MilkDrop visualizer in the now-playing views. Rendering by Butterchurn, the WebGL implementation of MilkDrop 2. Requires a browser with WebGL2. Google Cast receivers do not support WebGL, so cast dashboards keep their normal background.
